step1_figure.circuit_type: Three-stage Class AB Op-Amp with Indirect Miller Compensation
step1_figure.description: A three-stage operational amplifier featuring a self-cascoded NMOS differential input stage, a PMOS differential second stage, and a Class AB output stage. It uses indirect Miller compensation via capacitors C2 and C3 connected to the cascode nodes of the input stage.

open_loop_gain.description: DC open-loop gain of the op-amp

equation.explanation: Product of the gains of the three stages
equation.assumptions: Assuming typical gm and ro for 130nm

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming I_d = 5uA, Vov = 0.2V -> gm = 50uA/V, ro = 2MOhm. Stage 1 gain ≈ gm*ro = 100. Stage 2 gain ≈ 50. Stage 3 gain ≈ 100. Total gain = 500,000 V/V = 114 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on transistor lengths and exact biasing, but 3 stages typically yield >100dB.

unity_gain_frequency.description: Frequency where open-loop gain is 0 dB

equation.explanation: Determined by input stage transconductance and compensation capacitor

sky130_expected.reasoning: Scales with bias current and input pair sizing.

phase_margin.description: Phase difference from -180 degrees at unity-gain frequency

equation.assumptions: Higher order poles are beyond f_un

sky130_expected.calculation: Typically designed for 60 degrees for optimal step response without excessive ringing.

slew_rate.description: Maximum rate of change of the output voltage

equation.explanation: Limited by the current available to charge the compensation capacitor
equation.assumptions: Class A limitation in the input stage

sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the tail current of the input differential pair.

power_dissipation.description: Total DC power consumed by the op-amp

equation.explanation: Sum of all branch currents multiplied by supply voltage

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming total current of 100uA across all stages and bias circuit. P_diss = 1.8V * 100uA = 180 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the reference current and mirror ratios.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC open-loop gain, unity-gain frequency, phase margin, and transient slew rate.
